baseline_models.focus_anchor: The indefinite self is the shared feminine subject of knowing and bringing; its knowing follows its own act of making an object present.
baseline_models.mechanism: The living self causes its prior product to arrive within witnessing distance, and presence converts what was absent or dispersed into something clear to its maker.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive result produced when the self's object becomes clear.
The living soul-self supplies the continuing agent that both delivered the object and undergoes recognition.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness supply the transition from an absent product to evidence within the self's view.

changed_reading.before: A self simply remembers a list of past deeds.
changed_reading.after: The self knows when what it produced arrives before it as witnessed presence; cognition is an event of confrontation, not mere recollection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open relative object can include what was inward in the self, while the bringing verb gives that inward material an outward presence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hidden thought and intention belong to the self before they are observable; making them present removes the asymmetry between private motive and visible act, so the self recognizes both together.

activation_trace.role: Inner mind, thought, and hidden intent supply concealed content that can be included in what the self has brought.
Near witnessed presence gives inward content an inspectable form rather than leaving it private.
Becoming clear to the knower completes the movement from concealed motive to acknowledged content.

changed_reading.before: The self learns only which external actions stand on its record.
changed_reading.after: The self's previously private aims and thoughts are brought into the same field as their outward effects and become jointly knowable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The knowing root can image a mark that points beyond itself, and the self root can designate the very identity of a thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: What the self brings bears a distinguishing trace that points back to the identity that produced it; knowing is recognition of provenance through marks, not an unrelated announcement.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides toward its referent supplies the evidentiary link from product to producer.
The very thing or identity itself supplies the referent to which each distinguishing trace points.
Witnessed nearness makes the identifying trace available for recognition.

changed_reading.before: The self is told that a generic inventory belongs to it.
changed_reading.after: The brought material is self-identifying evidence: its marks lead the self back to its own authorship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same self is grammatically active in both bringing and knowing, so the verse joins agency to later recognition rather than presenting the self as a passive recipient only.
baseline_models.mechanism: Inner resolve issues in material made present; once delivered, that material returns as the basis of the agent's knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Resolve and inner mettle supply the initiating capacity behind what the self actively delivers.
Causing an object to reach near presence supplies the completed delivery for which the self remains responsible.
Clear recognition supplies the return of the delivered effect to the awareness of its agent.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is imposed on a passive self from outside.
changed_reading.after: The knowing self is also the proximate carrier and producer: it recognizes the material its own resolve delivered into presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wrapping scattered parts together, driving a group toward one destination, and filling a basin form an aggregation sequence. The focus then changes scale: one self confronts the total field of effects it has caused to arrive.

activation_trace.role: Near witnessed presence supplies the common destination at which dispersed effects can be encountered together.
Wrapping while joining parts supplies compaction of what had occupied a wider field.
Driving and collecting a group toward a destination supplies directed convergence rather than random accumulation.
Filling with water or its analogue supplies the image of a receiving field reaching total capacity.

structural_cues: Repeated passive transformations collect or concentrate large domains before the focus clause names an active human-scale bringer.
The focus result follows the entire conditional sequence, allowing earlier convergences to determine the scale of its object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrapping, directed gathering, filling, and focus presence; I infer that they form an aggregation template for the self's effects. A live alternative is that the cosmic clauses only stage simultaneity and do not specify how the focus object is assembled.

changed_reading.before: The self sees isolated deeds one by one.
changed_reading.after: Dispersed effects are compacted and convoyed into one field of presence, so the self knows a total configuration larger than a list of acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prominent celestial signs lose clarity and solid terrestrial heights are displaced. As public coordinates fail, the marks carried by the self's own effects become the remaining route to recognition.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing mark supplies an internal coordinate that can still point from evidence to the self.
A prominent sign supplies the public landmark whose loss makes private evidentiary marks newly decisive.
The opposite of clarity supplies the failure of a formerly legible celestial coordinate.
A hard elevated mass supplies the apparently fixed terrestrial landmark.
Removal and displacement supply the loss of that fixed landmark from its orienting position.

structural_cues: The opening sequence removes celestial light and terrestrial stability before the self knows.
The focus knowing root itself carries both cognition and marker branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prominent signs, loss of clarity, hard heights, and displacement; I assign them an orienting function and infer that self-marked evidence survives their collapse. They may instead function only as images of universal upheaval.

changed_reading.before: The self recognizes its record within an otherwise stable world.
changed_reading.after: When external coordinates fail, the self's own marked effects become its unavoidable orientation system and lead it back to itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: A near-term, heavily valued yield is left empty and nonfunctional. The focus object's importance therefore shifts from possessions the self expected to retain toward the consequences generated by its attachment to them.

activation_trace.role: Precious value desired and competed for by selves supplies the attachment whose real product must be distinguished from its object.
Presence supplies what remains available to the self after the valued possession itself is abandoned.
Ten-month gestation supplies an asset at the edge of expected fruition and therefore at peak practical value.
Emptiness and disabling supply the abrupt failure of that valued asset to function as retained cargo.

structural_cues: The valued subject is described at near-fruition and then passively abandoned.
The focus keeps the brought object open rather than naming possessions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-fruition, coveted value, and disabling emptiness; I infer that the self carries the effects of valuation when it cannot carry the valued asset. The alternative is a simpler urgency image with no claim about attachment.

changed_reading.before: What the self brought is what it successfully accumulated and retained.
changed_reading.after: The retained cargo is the pattern of desire and consequence produced around valuables, even when the valuables themselves are left empty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated self root moves from plural selves being paired or classified to one indefinite self knowing its brought object. This activates a relational account in which each self is joined to the effects or class that correspond to its work.

activation_trace.role: The living individual self supplies the singular unit that later recognizes its own correspondence.
Plural living selves supply the population across which pairings or classifications are made.
Peers gathered by shared form or work supply classification by likeness as the mechanism linking each self to a corresponding outcome.

structural_cues: The same self root appears first in a plural passive pairing and then in the singular active focus clause.
The focus object's open relative form permits a corresponding effect, companion, or class without deciding among them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural selves, grouping by shared form or work, and a singular self with brought material; I infer a self-to-effect pairing. A live alternative is that the earlier pairing joins selves only to other selves, not to deeds or outcomes.

changed_reading.before: Each self inspects an isolated private inventory.
changed_reading.after: Each self recognizes a correspondence: what it brought now stands as its peer, class, or fitting companion, without excluding literal pairing among selves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning, the split inventory's image of drawing something out from concealment, a terminal consequence, and killing activate the focus root's litigation branch. The self's knowing becomes compelled forensic recognition as hidden intent and downstream harm are produced at a hearing.

activation_trace.role: Contention and litigation supply the hearing-like frame in which the self's material is formally produced.
Hidden intent supplies interior evidence that a hearing must draw into the open alongside the act.
Asking and demanding supply the explicit interrogative pressure of the hearing.
The non-dominant mapped image of drawing out gently and secretly supplies an exploratory mechanism for extracting concealed evidence, not a replacement gloss for the question.
The tail or terminal part of a thing supplies downstream consequence as part of what must be answered for.
Taking life supplies the irreversible harm that prevents the inquiry from remaining abstract.

structural_cues: The missing-inventory root at 81:8 is used only structurally: a killed patient is questioned before the focus self knows.
The question passes directly into a why-of-killing clause and later into the self's recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, hidden extraction as a split-root branch, terminal consequence, killing, and a focus litigation branch; I infer a forensic hearing that makes the self a respondent. The alternative is moral interrogation without any courtroom mechanism, and the split branch may be only a form-distant activation.

changed_reading.before: The self privately notices its own actions.
changed_reading.after: A victim-centered question draws intent, act, and the tail of consequence into a contested presence, compelling the self to know what its agency produced.

context_deltas.mechanism: A written surface is opened, an overhead cover is peeled away, and something enclosed is driven near. These are successive removals of folding, cover, concealment, and distance, making the focus knowledge an externally staged disclosure rather than memory alone.

activation_trace.role: Becoming clear to a knower supplies the endpoint of every removal of concealment.
Near witnessed presence supplies the shared result of opening, peeling, and drawing close.
A written sheet supplies durable inscription as one carrier of the self's now-readable material.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the first removal of enclosure from the written carrier.
The sky or whatever rises as an overhead canopy supplies the largest covering surface in the sequence.
Removing a cover and exposing what was screened supplies the second, cosmic-scale unsealing.
Covering and concealment supply a still-hidden outcome after the written and cosmic surfaces open.
A drive into nearness removes the final spatial distance from the concealed outcome.

structural_cues: Ayat 10-13 progress from inscribed surface to overhead cover to opposed outcomes immediately before the focus result.
Each stage changes accessibility: folded to spread, covered to exposed, distant to near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written sheets, opening, an overhead cover, peeling, concealment, and nearness; I infer one layered disclosure mechanism terminating in focus knowledge. They may instead be independent signs whose only common feature is temporal simultaneity.

changed_reading.before: The self retrieves its record internally.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge arrives through a staged unsealing: inscription opens, covers are removed, and concealed consequences are brought within witnessing distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: One field is activated by ignition while another enclosed field is drawn near. The open object of the focus can therefore include not only past acts but the opposed environments those acts have helped make actual or proximate.

activation_trace.role: Near witnessed presence supplies the focus category under which opposed consequences become encounterable.
Intensely blazing fire supplies one fully developed consequence-field rather than a single isolated item.
Igniting and feeding fire supply activation of that field from latent to operative.
A garden enclosed by growth supplies the coexisting alternative consequence-field.
Movement into nearness supplies actual encounter with the alternative field.

structural_cues: The two opposed outcome clauses directly precede the focus clause.
The focus leaves what was brought grammatically open enough to contain effects, destinations, or whole conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ignited field and an enclosed field drawn near; I infer that the self's brought material causally conditions which environments become actual for it. A live alternative is that the outcomes are externally staged destinations rather than products of the self.

changed_reading.before: The object consists only of completed deeds carried forward.
changed_reading.after: The self knows the worlds its deeds activated or made near; acts and generated conditions coexist within what it brought.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreat into hiding passes through a thin nocturnal boundary and ends with morning breathing outward. Repetition of the self root as breath turns disclosure into an embodied emergence: concealed inward material is exhaled into presence, and knowing accompanies its appearance.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body gives the focus self a latent inside-to-outside motion.
Hidden inward thought supplies the content that the breathing motion can externalize.
Retreat into concealment supplies the initial inward phase of the disclosure cycle.
Celestial disappearance into hiding supplies a visible analogue for content withdrawn from view.
Thin darkness at either edge of night supplies the reversible threshold between concealment and exposure.
Morning's first light supplies the outward phase in which previously hidden content becomes visible.
Breathing outward explicitly repeats the focus root and activates emergence from interior to exterior.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves through retreat, hiding, liminal night, and morning breath.
The same root names the focus self and the context's breathing action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, a reversible night edge, morning, and repeated breath; I infer that this sequence models the self's hidden contents emerging into awareness. The live alternative is that dawn's breath is only a cosmic image and does not characterize the focus cognition.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is a sudden static verdict imposed at one instant.
changed_reading.after: The self's knowing is an embodied unsealing: what was held inward crosses a threshold, is breathed into presence, and becomes clear as it emerges.

context_deltas.mechanism: Utterance is carried by a messenger, secured by trust, corroborated by sight, and defined against concealment and withholding. This supplies a chain of custody by which what was absent becomes cognitively present to the self without eliminating direct self-recognition.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the endpoint that a trustworthy communication chain must produce.
Near witnessed presence supplies the epistemic effect of successfully delivered testimony.
Speech brought out in utterance supplies communicable content rather than inaccessible inward knowledge.
Messenger and message supply the carrier and transmitted object in the chain.
Settled confidence and trust supply the warrant that keeps transmission from becoming mere report.
Vision by eye or insight supplies independent witnessing that corroborates the carried utterance.
What is screened from eyes supplies the absent domain that transmission makes accessible.
Withholding, explicitly negated in the context, supplies the rejected blockage and thereby defines an open channel.

structural_cues: Ayat 19-24 shift from the announced utterance through messenger credentials to sight and non-withholding.
Negations remove competing failures of the witness and transmission chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies utterance, messenger, trust, sight, hidden content, and negated withholding; I infer an epistemic delivery mechanism for the focus knowledge. The self may still know directly, with the later sequence validating only the announcement rather than mediating the experience.

changed_reading.before: The self's knowledge is wholly private and unmediated.
changed_reading.after: Direct recognition can coexist with warranted transmission: a trusted chain brings the formerly unseen within the self's cognitive presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A reminder restores what had been retained but inactive, while a distinguishing mark points toward its referent. The focus knowing can thus be re-cognition: latent self-knowledge is activated when a reminder makes its own traces legible.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark supplies the trace through which dormant knowledge can be reidentified.
Bringing something back after forgetting, or retaining it in memory, supplies reactivation rather than first acquisition.
A reminder-object supplies the external activator that makes an internal trace operative.
The repeated marker branch scales legibility beyond one self and lets the reminder function as a shared orienting sign.

structural_cues: The reminder clause precedes the two clauses about willing and direction.
The focus knowing root recurs in the context's collective addressee term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recall after forgetting, a reminder-object, and repeated marker imagery; I infer that the reminder activates knowledge already latent in the self. It may instead teach genuinely new information rather than reactivate retained knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The self receives information it never possessed.
changed_reading.after: A reminder-sign reactivates what the self had carried latently, so the final knowing is recognition of its own now-legible trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus makes the self a real proximate bringer, while the closing sequence links willing to a thing, upright direction, an explicitly divine source, and formative completion. Agency remains attributable to the self but is no longer autonomous or self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Inner resolve supplies genuine proximate agency in what the self brings.
Causing material to reach presence supplies the completed effect still grammatically attributed to the self.
Willing attached to a thing supplies intentional selection rather than automatic motion.
Uprightness, balance, and straightness supply the direction into which willing can be enacted.
Repeated willing toward a thing supplies the syntactic nesting of human intention within a larger intention.
The worshipped deity supplies the explicitly named encompassing agent of the second will.
Formation, nurture, and completion supply the larger process within which the self's chosen direction reaches actuality.

structural_cues: The focus assigns bringing to the self, while the closing two ayat place human willing inside divine willing.
The sequence preserves two grammatical agents instead of replacing one with the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-attributed bringing, two levels of willing, straightness, deity, and formative completion; I infer nested causation that preserves proximate responsibility. The larger will may instead be permissive framing rather than co-production of each brought effect.

changed_reading.before: The self is either wholly autonomous in what it brings or merely passive under an external decree.
changed_reading.after: The self genuinely brings and therefore knows its effects, while its resolve and completion operate within an encompassing will; responsibility and dependence coexist.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surfaces do not denote childbirth or afterbirth, yet it remains anchored in convergent focus-root branches for birth, gathered aftermatter, and disclosure, with the bringing construction preserving production. Downstream prose should present it only as a reproductive-material analogy for generated consequences and residue, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Two focus roots independently supply bringing forth life and the residue gathered after emergence, while the open object can include both intended product and remainder.

activation_trace.role: Birth and postpartum emergence supply a material model of the self bringing forth something generated from within.
Gathered bodily residue or afterbirth supplies the remainder that accompanies production but is not identical with the intended product.
Becoming clear to the knower turns both product and residue into acknowledged consequence.

changed_reading.before: Only deliberately completed acts count as what the self brought.
changed_reading.after: What the self brought forth may include an intended product and the unintended residue generated with it; both become knowable consequences.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain hydrological reading is surprising, but all three focus roots independently contain water-related branches and the context activates seas being filled or depleted. It is valid as a material systems analogy anchored in the focus, and downstream prose should qualify it as an ecological model of accumulated and exhausted life-support, not as the verse's lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots converge on gathered water, life-sustaining drink, and return to a watering place, allowing the brought object to be modeled as flows returning to an accounting point.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water supplies accumulation at a scale larger than isolated drops or acts.
Life-sustaining water or drink supplies the dependence of the self on the resource it consumes and affects.
Return to permanent water supplies the convergence point where dispersed use becomes present for accounting.
Vast abundant water supplies the contextual system in which individual flows aggregate.
Filling with water supplies one live terminal state of the system.
Water receding into emptiness supplies the opposed live terminal state without forcing a choice between fullness and depletion.

changed_reading.before: The self confronts only discrete moral tokens.
changed_reading.after: The self confronts the returned state of life-sustaining flows it helped fill, divert, or exhaust, so systemic resource effects coexist with discrete acts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the running branch of the bringing root is form-distant from ordinary presence, but it remains anchored in the focus causative verb and is activated by contextual running and the explicit question of destination. Downstream prose should call it a kinetic analogy in which cargo and route disclose one another, not substitute 'run' for the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bringing root can image causing an animal to run, so the self's object can be carried as something set on a trajectory whose destination later reveals its origin.

activation_trace.role: Running or causing a mount to run supplies the exploratory kinetic force inside the self's active bringing.
Resolve supplies the agent's initial direction rather than treating movement as accidental.
Continuous running or flowing supplies a contextual trajectory along which brought material can travel.
A way, destination, or adopted path supplies the question answered by the direction of the self's cargo.

changed_reading.before: The self's cargo is a stationary pile at the endpoint.
changed_reading.after: What the self set moving has traced a route; on arrival, the cargo reveals not only what the self did but where its chosen motion was taking it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the contextual withholding is negated of another speaker, so transferring it to the focus self is contrastive and cross-role. It remains anchored in focus branches for coveted value and presence plus context branches for hiddenness and withholding; downstream prose must label it an analogy of omission becoming evidence and must not imply that the trusted speaker withholds anything.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The open object can include a valued thing the self kept absent, because the act of withholding leaves a relation that can itself be made present and known.

activation_trace.role: Preciousness desired by selves supplies the motive for hoarding or restricting access.
Witnessed presence supplies the reversal by which an attempted absence becomes inspectable evidence.
Being screened from eyes supplies the state the self may have tried to preserve.
Holding something back supplies omission as an action with its own evidentiary trace, while the context's negation keeps the speaker exempt.
Precious exclusivity supplies the value relation that explains why access was restricted.

changed_reading.before: Only what the self positively sent forward can be brought into its account.
changed_reading.after: What the self hoarded, omitted, or kept hidden can arrive as a present relation of withholding; absence itself leaves knowable evidence.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from private recollection to witnessed arrival of a total field of self-produced effects.
Pairing and forensic questioning made knowledge relational and victim-centered rather than an isolated self-audit.
Opened records, peeled covers, breathing dawn, and trusted transmission supplied several coexisting mechanisms by which hidden material becomes present.
The closing wills preserved the self as proximate bringer while nesting its agency within formative divine completion.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated focus roots, a legitimate split-root hidden-extraction branch, active-versus-passive sequencing, and cross-root material convergences kept several changed readings alive without collapsing them into one verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The open object may range across deeds, intentions, downstream consequences, corresponding companions, and whole outcome-fields.
The self's knowing may be immediate, reminder-reactivated, externally disclosed, or supported by trusted transmission; the packet permits coexistence but does not rank them.
The causal arrow from self-brought acts to the two outcome environments is plausible but reader-supplied.
The birth-residue, hydrological, trajectory, and withheld-absence models are branch-anchored analogies and should not be rendered as direct lexical senses.
